title: Observation-Aligned Mask Priors for Learning Physical Fields from Authentic Occlusions
abstract: arXiv:2605.16818v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning physical fields directly from incomplete observations is challenging because authentic occlusions are structured, sample-dependent, and often missing not at random, whereas existing methods typically rely on heuristic masking rules or predefined mask distributions. We propose Observation-Aligned Mask Priors, a framework that learns the distribution of authentic observation masks and uses it to construct context-query partitions for training from incomplete data. Specifically, we pretrain a Bayesian Flow Network (BFN) on binary observation masks to capture real occlusion topologies, then guide BFN sampling with a globally normalized cross-entropy objective to generate sample-specific masks aligned with each sparse observation. translated_title: 面向从真实遮挡中学习物理场的观测对齐掩码先验
translated_abstract: 直接从不完整观测中学习物理场具有挑战性，因为真实的遮挡是结构化的、依赖于具体样本的，且通常属于非随机缺失，而现有方法通常依赖启发式掩码规则或预定义的掩码分布。我们提出了观测对齐掩码先验，这是一个学习真实观测掩码分布的框架，并利用该分布构建上下文-查询划分，以从不完整数据中进行训练。具体而言，我们在二值观测掩码上预训练贝叶斯流网络（BFN）以捕捉真实遮挡的拓扑结构，然后使用全局归一化的交叉熵目标引导BFN采样，生成与每个稀疏观测对齐的样本特定掩码。引导掩码与观测掩码的交集定义了上下文，剩余的观测条目则成为基于扩散的重建模型的查询目标。我们证明了……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出观测对齐掩码先验框架，利用贝叶斯流网络学习真实遮挡掩码的分布并生成与稀疏观测对齐的样本特定掩码，从而实现从不完整观测数据中有效学习物理场。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Observation-Aligned Mask Priors, a framework that leverages a Bayesian Flow Network to learn the distribution of authentic occlusion masks and generate sample-specific masks aligned with sparse observations, enabling effective learning of physical fields from incomplete data.
